definitions.gloss: groper; molester; sexual offender on public transport
definitions.explanation: A person who commits groping or other forms of sexual harassment, especially on crowded trains or in public places. Also refers to the act itself. A persistent social problem in Japan that has led to women-only train cars and anti-groping campaigns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{痴漢|ちかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
examples.english: I was groped on the train.

⟦{満員|まんいん}{電車|でんしゃ}→満員電車：08350_manindensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{痴漢|ちかん}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{女性専用車両|じょせいせんようしゃりょう}→女性専用車両：08490_joseisenyousharyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Women-only train cars were introduced to prevent groping on crowded trains.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers both to the person who gropes and to the act of groping. {痴漢|ちかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧ means "to be groped" (to encounter a groper). {痴漢|ちかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to grope someone."

CULTURAL NOTE:
Groping on crowded trains is a recognized social problem in Japan. Many railway companies have introduced ⟦{女性専用車両|じょせいせんようしゃりょう}→女性専用車両：08490_joseisenyousharyou⟧ (women-only cars) during rush hours. Posters warning against {痴漢|ちかん} are common in stations. False accusations are also a concern, leading some men to keep their hands visible on trains.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {痴漢|ちかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be groped
- {痴漢|ちかん}⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: act of groping
- {痴漢|ちかん}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: groping victimization
- {痴漢|ちかん}⟦{冤罪|えんざい}→冤罪：08392_enzai⟧: false accusation of groping
- {痴漢|ちかん}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧: groping prevention
